description: List the tile-scan items produced by one run (status, country, offer URL, absolute screenshot URL, report_url + public_report_url deep-links, elapsed ms, error). Link users to a scan with the returned `report_url` (auth dashboard) or `public_report_url` (shareable) — never hand-build URLs. For full scan details (input URL, labels, classification, redirect chain) fetch a specific scan via `get_scan`.
name: list_run_scans
title: List Run Scans
